items.label: f03-step-transitions
items.back: PENDING -> QUEUED, WAITING_APPROVAL, SUCCEEDED or SKIPPED; QUEUED -> RUNNING or FAILED; RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED or FAILED; WAITING_APPROVAL -> SUCCEEDED or FAILED; FAILED -> QUEUED (retry); SUCCEEDED and SKIPPED are terminal.

items.label: f01-happy-path-order
items.front: startWorkflowRun call order on a first start
items.back: lookup -> version -> parse -> tx (create) -> tx-done -> seed -> reload. A replay stops after lookup; a missing version stops after version (404); a parse failure stops after parse.

items.label: f02-repair-gap
items.back: runs:repair exists (ADMIN and OPERATOR hold it) but no route or service uses it. A run whose seed failed stays PENDING with no steps, and replays return it without seeding again; the repair path still has to be designed.

items.prompt: A run was started with key k; its definition has since been retired. The same user replays k. What happens?

choices.text: A new run on the version that replaced the retired one
A 404, as no active version exists for the definition now

items.explanation: The replay branch returns before the version lookup and the parse, so validation never runs for a replay. Correct for idempotency, but a retired definition does not affect replays.
